svg.title: Kumo Tabular small - classifier
svg.desc: NVIDIA - cell embedding -> column/row blocks -> in-context stack · 27.5 M parameters. Symbols in shapes: n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; n_test: test rows (the rows being predicted); R: rows; C: columns. Abbreviations: ICL: in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled training rows; MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); RMSNorm: root-mean-square normalisation; QK: query and key (as in QK-norm); KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads). How to read: the data flows upwards, from the input table to the prediction; a line up the right-hand side ending in a circled plus: a residual connection, adding the input of the steps it passes back to their output; a box at the left meeting the flow at a circled plus: that stage's output is added to the flow; concat / prepend: a stage's output joins as an extra column, or as learned rows or columns put in front; N ×: the steps in the tinted container are stacked N times; alternating: Column block and Row block take turns, one of each per repeat, rather than one stack after the other; small boxes at the left feed the step their arrow points to; dark boxes are attention; the line under the name says where its keys come from, which tokens query in the last block, how it is scaled, and how many key/value heads the test rows read; beside the arrows: the tensor shape each stage emits, in the symbols above; dotted lines: facts about the part they point to, with the numbers in the model's colour.
svg.text: NVIDIA - cell embedding -> column/row blocks -> in-context stack · 27.5 M parameters
Inducing points attend to the context rows
Rows attend to the inducing summary
last block queries: readout tokens · gated log-n
